title: Nonlinear ellipse rotation, driven by a digitised spectrum
summary: Ten 3 mm fused-silica plates rotate the polarisation ellipse of a digitised 1030 nm pulse (ellipticity 0.3, 3 µJ, B = 1.39 rad) by 10.23 deg, within 2 % of the analytic 10.07 deg; a simulated OSA trace after the plates agrees with the recording to 0.43 % rms.
